The '''''G-79''''' was the designation of the [[Drone barge/Legends|drone barge]] dispatched by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] to transport [[Wrenga Jixton]] to [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]], on his mission to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Lexhannen Torlock|Torlock]].
